story: Registry → explicit tool review → native durable runner → typed progress/result → queue Reveal/Undo → restart; scoped Search discovers tools/notes/links/pins/Shelf/clipboard.

requirements.assertions: One metadata registry describes id/name/category/icon/keywords/accepts/presets/form and dispatches through run to an internal executor. Two real base executors (To JPG/To MP4), no fake runnable catalog. Search, selected Shelf actions and review form consume this registry. Native picker accepts only supported file extensions. Selection never runs a job; one primary Run action, advanced quality collapsed. Broader drop/Send To/clipboard integrations remain V5.11 and complete catalog remains V5.9/V5.10.

Persist validated result-named presets and jobs in SQLite, including request idempotency, UTC timestamps, preset snapshots, attempts/retryOf, progress, output hash/identity and staging publication journal. Defaults Discord20/email25/Outlook10/WhatsApp100 MB; Settings Files edits limits. A single sleeping native queue worker pushes typed ToolJob/ToolResult and tools:changed, with no collapsed JS timer. Cancel keeps records and stops owned process trees; retry is a new request with original preset snapshot. Active quit confirmation defaults Cancel; stop cancels and joins. Restart never auto-runs interrupted work.

Use exclusive owned staging, locked source and before/after hashes; publish atomically without replace with numbered collisions. Copy modified/created dates where supported and report inability. Journal before publication and recover only matching file identity/hash. Compact/Peek/queue show actual sizes/progress/error. Reveal and Undo are native Shell calls; Undo rejects replaced/edited outputs and requests Recycle Bin with fail-fast error behavior, then verifies removal before recording success. Native acceptance substitutes owned guarded providers only.

Search compatible tools, visible active scoped notes/bookmarks including saved links, pins, Shelf and clipboard. Current-scope validation and generations prevent stale workspace results/navigation. Subscribe before first fetch; listener errors fail closed, changes push invalidation, no idle polling or filesystem/profile scan. Keyboard arrows/Enter/Escape respect composition. Saved-card navigation is scope-guarded; tool opens review; Shelf selects the stored item. Archive/trash excluded by visibleNotes scope.
